bio: In 2025, this restaurant celebrates a century of existence, as a veritable treasure trove of history that has preserved its family soul intact. Today, the kitchen is run by Lorenza, heir to a tradition that smells of Emilia and Piacenza, the same tradition lovingly preserved by her mother. The dishes arrive at the table generous and steaming, with classic flavours that seduce the eye and the palate. The wine list, which is now digital, boasts around 350 labels: the treasures of Northern Italy prevail, but there are also international notes. For the perfect pairing, let yourself be guided by Giorgio, the fourth generation of the family in the dining room. With grace and expertise, he will transform every sip into a harmonious accompaniment to your dish....
